content:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — we’re seeing a spike in 5xxs from APAC-hosted inference endpoints starting ~12:05 UTC. Error rates ~8% for a subset of customers. Investigating.
Mateo Ortiz: Investigating ingress auth proxy logs now. Seeing a surge of token-refresh failures 401 -> cascade to 503 from upstreams.
Priya Rao: I rolled the auth-proxy change from the 02:30 deploy to canary earlier — linking deploy: <https://ci.redwood/example/1234|deploy-1234>. Could be related.
eng-oncall-bot: alert: auth-proxy: token-refresh-error-rate > threshold (8%) — paging oncall.
Alice Chen: Mitigation plan: 1) pause canary and block new traffic to the changed proxy nodes; 2) enable token refresh rate-limiting on proxy; 3) fail-open to cached tokens for 5m window. Executing now.
Mateo Ortiz: Paused canary via infra. Command run: ```./infra ctl traffic shift --service auth-proxy --from canary --to stable``` — cutting new sessions to canary nodes.
Priya Rao: Adding temporary retry/backoff change in client gateway to reduce token churn. Pushing patch now.
deploy-bot: redeploy started: auth-proxy stable rollback triggered by Priya Rao (run id: dpl-7890).
Alice Chen: Notifying CS + statuspage. Drafting update: "Investigating increased errors in APAC caused by auth-proxy token refresh storm; rollback in progress. No customer data exposure. More updates in 15m."
incident-bot: statuspage update queued: <https://status.redwood.com/incidents/abc123|Incident ABC123> — maintenance window set to 30m.
Mateo Ortiz: After pausing canary, 5xx rate down to ~1.2% in APAC edge region us-ap1. Latency normals returning.
Alice Chen: Continuing to watch. CS notified top 5 impacted customers directly (DMs sent).
Priya Rao: Rollback finished, proxy pods scaled back to stable; enabling token refresh rate limiter (60/min per token).
Mateo Ortiz: Post-mitigation: error rate ~0.3% and falling, KV-cache hit rate unaffected. Monitoring for 20m.
Alice Chen: Root-cause hypothesis: recent canary introduced a token refresh loop when upstream returned intermittent 401s -> thundering refresh. Follow-ups: (1) add graceful backoff and jitter to client; (2) harden token refresh retries in proxy; (3) add canary synthetic checks for auth flow. Owners: Priya (code), Mateo (infra), Alice (postmortem).
Priya Rao: Will open a PR with tests and add a canary auth smoke test. ETA first pass 24h.
Alice Chen: Postmortem ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521 — will post full writeup after triage.
eng-oncall-bot: incident status: mitigated — monitoring.
Alice Chen: Closing thread for now, will re-open if regression. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
